$comment: Report registry: one entry per report / dashboard tab. The build copies each script (and the other .ps1/.csv files in its folder) to scripts/, and each dashboard to www/reports/<id>.html. Schedules are app settings (see Terraform var.report_schedules) referenced by each timer function's function.json.

reports.title: Least privilege
reports.description: Admin actions compared with the Entra roles held at the time.

reports.title: Azure changes
reports.description: Resources created, changed and deleted across all subscriptions, and who did it.

reports.title: Authentication methods
reports.description: Registered sign-in methods per user and how strong they are.

reports.title: Applications
reports.description: App registrations and enterprise apps: last sign-in and ownership.
